drophunting_activities.description:
**Description**

This endpoint returns a list of drophunting activities similar to [cryptorank.io/drophunting](https://cryptorank.io/drophunting). Results can be tailored using pagination (`limit`, `skip`), sorting (`sortBy`, `sortDirection`), and filters (`activityStatus`, `rewardType`). Each activity includes:
- *Tasks* (type, status, cost, required time) — Exclusive tasks are available only with the Business plan (in the endpoint v2/drophunting/activities/with-exclusive).
- *Funds* that invested in the project
- *Total raised funds*
- *Social metrics* (X network score and subscriber count)

**Pricing**
- 1 credit for each request up to 100 items, with any excess rounded up (e.g., 101-200 items will cost 2 credits).
- 1 credit for each applied filter.

### Access & Availability
- ✅ Included in: Pro, Business
- 🛒 Available for purchase in: Basic, Advanced
- ❌ Not available in: Sandbox

query.name: status
query.description: Filters results by the specified activity status, returning only activities with a matching status

query.name: reward
query.description: Filters results by the specified reward type, returning only activities with that matching type

query.name: sortBy
query.description: The field by which the results are sorted

query.name: sortDirection
query.description: The sorting direction: ascending (`ASC`) or descending (`DESC`)

query.name: limit
query.description: Number of activities to return in a single request

query.name: skip
query.description: Number of activities to skip (useful for pagination in combination with `limit`)

ecosystems_map.description:
**Description**

This endpoint provides a lightweight list of `id`, `slug`, `name`, `projectsCount`, `Tags`. The response delivers essential details for efficient identification and categorization. Filtering by `Tags` is also supported for targeted queries.

**Pricing**
- 1 credit per request;
- +1 additional credit if filtering is applied.

### Access & Availability
- ✅ Included in: Sandbox, Basic, Advanced, Pro, Business

query.name: tagId
query.description: Tag to filter by. Full list of tags can be accessed with this endpoint: `/ecosystems/tags`

ecosystems_tags.description:
**Description**

This endpoint provides information about all ecosystem `Tags`. This data is required for proper interaction with other endpoints.

**Pricing**
- 1 credit per request.

### Access & Availability
- ✅ Included in: Sandbox, Basic, Advanced, Pro, Business

ecosystems_by_id.summary: Full  Metrics for a Specific Ecosystem
ecosystems_by_id.description:
**Description**

This endpoint returns a specific ecosystem with a full data set including: `id`, `name`, `slug`, `logo`, `projectsCount`, `newProjectsCount`, `marketCap`, `marketCapChangePercent`, `tvl`, `tvlChangePercent`, `funds`, `Tags`, `links`, `shortDescription`, `categories`.

**Pricing**
- 1 credit per request.

### Access & Availability
- ✅ Included in: Advanced, Pro, Business
- ❌ Not available in: Sandbox, Basic

ecosystems_by_id_projects.summary: Project list for a Specific Ecosystem
ecosystems_by_id_projects.description:
**Description**

This endpoint returns a list of projects associated with a specific ecosystem, including: `name`, `logo`, `shortDescription`, `categories`. Pagination is applied with 100 items per request. Filtering is available by `categories` and `tag`.

**Pricing**
- Pagination is set to 100 projects per page;
- 1 credit per request for up to 100 results, 2 credits for 101–200, and so on;
- Each request costs 1 credit for up to 100 entries, with additional credits for larger queries or filter usage.

### Access & Availability
- ✅ Included in: Advanced, Pro, Business
- ❌ Not available in: Sandbox, Basic
